title: CCCView: A Knowledge Platform for Integrated Analysis of Spatial Transcriptomic Cell-Cell Communication.
snippet: Spatial transcriptomics enables investigation of cell-cell communication (CCC) while preserving spatial context, yet large-scale resources that organize spatial CCC results across studies and make them readily searchable, visualizable, and comparable remain limited.
